text.p: Investment company Hancock and Gore Ltd said on Tuesday it would make a takeover offer for hatmaker Leutenneger Ltd comprising one Hancock and Gore share for every four Leutenneger shares.
Hancock and Gore shares were up two cents at A$1.30 at 3.20 p.m. (0420 GMT), while Leutenegger shares were untraded, having closed at 19 cents per share on Friday.
The bid therefore values Lutenegger's 17.3 million shares at about A$5.6 million or 32.5 cents per share.
"The proposed HGL (Hancock and Gore) offer will give Leutenegger shareholders the opportunity to have a continuing stake in the Leutenegger businesses," HGL said in a statement.
"At the same time they will become shareholders in a successful company with a broader range of industrial businesses and a track record of rising earnings and consistent dividends," HGL said.
The takeover offer is subject to HGL becoming entitled to no less than 90 percent of Leutenegger shares.
